title: A persistent unemployment shock
hook: Two stated cases: explore the persistence assumption rather than automatic full recovery.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the persistence assumption rather than automatic full recovery affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Level, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the persistence assumption rather than automatic full recovery in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: Toy level is baseline 5 plus shock -2 times exp(-Decay 0.01 × Time 12). What level results?

claims.text: An assumed fading shock produces adaptation toward the baseline. Real wellbeing need not follow this curve or recover fully. This comparison isolates the persistence assumption rather than automatic full recovery.
